# Get all existing note titles to avoid duplicates
existing_titles = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=sn_token,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20,
        dont_reorder_pinned=True
    )
    for note in page:
        existing_titles.add(note['title'])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Existing note titles: {existing_titles}")

# Process each file
for file_path in files:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(
        file_path=file_path,
        access_token=fs_token
    )
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Derive title from filename
    # Get basename by splitting on '/'
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Remove .md extension
    if basename.endswith('.md'):
        basename = basename[:-3]
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    title = basename.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Check if note already exists
    if title in existing_titles:
        print(f"Skipping existing note: {title}")
        continue
    
    # Create the note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        title=title,
        content=content,
        access_token=sn_token
    )
    print(f"Created note: {title} -> {result}")
